name: Floor Scrubber Battery
definition: A floor-scrubber battery profile covers the battery or pack, chemistry, voltage, capacity, mechanical, charge, communication and duty boundaries used in floorcare equipment; it does not make batteries interchangeable by voltage alone.
includedScope: Flooded lead-acid, AGM, gel and lithium floor-machine families
Pack voltage, capacity, envelope, mass, terminal, charger and BMS checks
Walk-behind and ride-on floorcare duty contexts
excludedScope: Unverified battery, charger or machine interchangeability
headline: Matching voltage is not enough—capacity basis, dimensions, mass, terminals, charger and BMS must all match.
description: This profile separates battery chemistry, shift-duty performance and exact machine/charger integration checks so buyers can compare documented floorcare power options safely.
metaDescription: Floor scrubber battery chemistries, voltage and capacity, deep-cycle families, charger and BMS requirements, runtime boundaries and compatibility checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, electrical and control specification, mechanical and fluid or airflow interfaces, protection requirements and approved service documentation.

keyFacts.label: Chemistry families
keyFacts.value: Flooded, AGM and lithium options have different service and charging boundaries
keyFacts.evidence: Trojan, U.S. Battery and Discover publish multiple chemistry families for floor machines.

keyFacts.label: Pack identity
keyFacts.value: Nominal voltage does not define usable energy, current capability or fit
keyFacts.evidence: Official product pages publish separate voltage, capacity, dimensions, weight and terminal fields.

keyFacts.label: System boundary
keyFacts.value: Battery, charger, BMS and machine controls must be approved together
keyFacts.evidence: U.S. Battery describes BMS/CAN features for its 24 V floor-machine lithium system; Trojan and Discover separate chemistry-specific solutions.
keyFacts.scope: Named official lithium and floorcare systems.

systemRole.name: Energy storage
systemRole.role: Stores electrical energy within a documented voltage, capacity and temperature range.
systemRole.evidence: Official battery pages publish voltage, capacity and product dimensions.

systemRole.name: Traction and cleaning load
systemRole.role: Supplies motors, pumps and controls through the machine's shift-duty profile.
systemRole.evidence: Manufacturers position deep-cycle families for floor machines and floorcare equipment.
systemRole.scope: Application-level positioning, not a runtime guarantee.

systemRole.name: Charge acceptance
systemRole.role: Receives energy only through a chemistry- and pack-compatible charger profile.
systemRole.evidence: Manufacturers separate flooded, AGM and lithium systems and publish product-specific charge requirements.

systemRole.name: Protection and communication
systemRole.role: Lithium packs may use a BMS and machine or charger communication.
systemRole.evidence: U.S. Battery identifies BMS and CAN communication for its named 24 V floor-machine product.

architectures.name: Flooded lead-acid
architectures.operatingPrinciple: Lead plates operate in liquid electrolyte and require the manufacturer's ventilation and maintenance regime.
limitations: Spill and watering controls are application-specific
architectures.buyerCheck: Verify case, terminals, watering, ventilation, charger profile and maintenance responsibility.
architectures.evidence: Trojan, U.S. Battery and Discover list flooded floor-machine options.

architectures.name: Valve-regulated AGM or gel
architectures.operatingPrinciple: Electrolyte is immobilized in a sealed valve-regulated construction.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Used where maintenance and installation constraints differ from flooded batteries.
limitations: Sealed does not mean unrestricted orientation or environment
architectures.buyerCheck: Match AGM or gel charging, vents, dimensions, terminals and stated operating position.
architectures.evidence: Discover and EnerSys describe AGM/gel floorcare alternatives.

architectures.name: Lithium-ion / LiFePO4 pack
architectures.operatingPrinciple: Cells, BMS, contactors and communication form a managed battery system.
architectures.applicationBoundary: Published for selected floor-machine systems and shift-duty use.
limitations: BMS and charger integration are mandatory
Cold, transport and approval limits vary
architectures.buyerCheck: Approve the pack, charger, BMS communications, firmware, connector and machine current profile together.
architectures.evidence: U.S. Battery and Discover publish lithium floorcare systems with managed electronics.

specifications.name: Nominal pack voltage
specifications.reportingBoundary: Cell/battery series arrangement and charge voltage remain separate
specifications.comparisonCaution: Do not approve a replacement by 24 V, 36 V or 48 V alone.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.

specifications.name: Capacity
specifications.reportingBoundary: Ah must retain rate, temperature, cutoff and cycle basis
specifications.comparisonCaution: Do not compare Ah values with different discharge rates.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.

specifications.name: Usable energy and duty
specifications.purchasingMeaning: Connects the pack to the machine load profile
specifications.reportingBoundary: Runtime depends on machine current, duty, temperature and cutoff
specifications.comparisonCaution: Do not promise runtime from battery capacity alone.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.

specifications.name: Dimensions and mass
specifications.purchasingMeaning: Control tray fit, restraint and axle loading
specifications.reportingBoundary: Length, width, height, handles and center of gravity matter
specifications.comparisonCaution: A smaller battery may also change ballast and stability.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.

specifications.name: Terminals and connector
specifications.purchasingMeaning: Define safe electrical connection and polarity
specifications.reportingBoundary: Terminal type, location, cable, fuse and connector keying are separate
specifications.comparisonCaution: Do not modify cables without current and protection review.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.

specifications.name: Charge and communication
specifications.purchasingMeaning: Define charger profile and managed-system integration
specifications.reportingBoundary: Chemistry, charge curve, BMS/CAN and firmware must match
specifications.comparisonCaution: A charger that reaches the same voltage may still be incompatible.
specifications.evidence: Official sources publish this field or the related product boundary for named families.
specifications.scope: Use the exact source and current model documentation; field labels and test points vary by manufacturer.
